command.description: Run a project-local command during setup, diagnostics, or headless proof. Prefer UI actions only when the recipe must prove visible interaction.

app.status.description: Query the dev-only Farmslot Expo bridge to confirm the app is reachable.

app.hud.description: Display one concise human intent line from the current recipe node.

app.trace.description: Emit a lightweight bridge trace event for recipe timeline observability.

ui.press.description: Press a native accessibility target on the assigned simulator or device.

ui.set_input.description: Set native input text without retaining plaintext in recipe artifacts.

ui.scroll.description: Scroll the assigned native simulator or device and wait for stability.

ui.wait_for.description: Wait for native accessibility content and UI stability.

ui.screenshot.description: Capture the assigned native simulator or device into the artifact package.

capabilities.reason: Supported on macOS when capture-helper is installed; node health reports runtime availability per machine.

observers.description: Current native app identity after supported UI actions.
Bounded visible native accessibility targets after supported UI actions.
